messages:
evan: dropping a new mock for the deployments panel — compact history + canary preview + a persistent Rewind CTA. link: https://www.figma.com/file/new-deploy (frame 9). looking for quick copy + keyboard/a11y checks. mira: main feel: the compact list is ✨ but the Rewind label is ambiguous. users ask "rewind what?" Suggest "Rewind to vX" on hover, and a persistent helper text: 'Rewind restores model, config & traffic'. keep helper text brief. samir: agree on explicitness. also we should differentiate 'Rewind' (undo recent action) vs 'Rollback' (force revert). maybe use 'Rewind' for short window undo + 'Rollback' for permanent revert. UX: Rewind CTA = subtle primary, Rollback in modal = destructive red. joel: keyboard notes: when Rewind toast appears, it should not steal focus. instead announce via role="status" and include an inline keyboard action (press U to undo). also add shortcut hint next to persistent CTA: "(U)". sample toast snippet: ```
Rewound to v12 — press U to undo
``` mira: a11y-lint: compact allocation chips currently just show "5%". SR users lose context out of flow. please add aria-label on chips: aria-label="Allocation 5 percent for variant v2". visually keep "5%". ev an: also, the timeline scrubber uses tiny steps and keyboard jumps are inconsistent. propose a variable step strategy: if current total range <=10% step=1, <=50 step=5, else step=10. add data-step attr and document behavior in the component. samir: color tokens: rollback destructive text uses token danger-500 on dark header. contrast calc ~3.6:1. need 4.5:1. option: use danger-700 or filled pill for destructive action. will open PR to update token map and include dark-mode swatches. joel: focus management for rollback modal: trap focus, set initial focus on the destructive button? I recommend initial focus on the primary safe action (Cancel) to avoid accidental destructive confirm via Enter. but allow keyboard users to tab to Confirm. add aria-describedby linking to brief consequences. mira: voiceover playback note: when scrubbing, SR reads value but not which variant. add aria-valuetext on the scrub handle: e.g., aria-valuetext="v7, 20 percent". also aria-roledescription="deployment timeline scrubber". a11y-bot: automated scan results: - Compact allocation chips missing aria-label (12 occurrences). - Rollback text contrast fail in dark header (computed 3.62). - Scrub control missing aria-valuetext and aria-roledescription. - Rewind toast missing role="status" (not announced). - Modal focus trap not documented (suggest add data-focus-trap attr). ev an: proposed action items: 1) design: update Rewind hover state to show "Rewind to vX" + header helper text; mark Rewind CTA with shortcut hint (mira + evan) 2) eng: add aria-label to allocation chips, aria-valuetext & aria-roledescription on scrubber, expose data-step attr for variable jumps (joel + samir) 3) infra/styles: fix contrast token for destructive text in dark header (samir) 4) ux writing: short helper copy options for Rewind hover & modal rationale (mira) samir: i'll draft a PR for color tokens and a tiny CSS example for filled destructive pill. joel: i'll implement aria-valuetext and keyboard shortcut wiring in the component branch and leave notes for VO testing. mira: copy options to review: - header helper: "Rewind restores model, config & traffic" - hover: "Rewind to v12" - modal body line: "This will revert to v12 and restore previous traffic allocation." ev an: timeline: can we get updated mocks + token suggestion by Wed EOD? i'll block a review slot Thu morning. mira: will post updated figma frames tonight with aria annotations. joel: will schedule a quick VO test after PR lands. samir: thanks all — I'll include contrast numbers in the PR so it's clear which token to use. :white_check_mark:
